business_problem: Nextar had to bring mostly offline retailers online during COVID and provide fast catalog search while keeping inventory and orders synchronized in real time.
solution_summary: Nextar extended its POS-based retail platform with MongoDB Atlas as the operational backbone for inventory, orders, and storefront catalogs when COVID forced mostly offline merchants to sell online. Atlas keeps each shop's transactional and catalog data in flexible per-store collections so sales, stock levels, and display rules stay synchronized in real time. MongoDB Search on Atlas adds Lucene-based search directly on top of the same data for online storefronts, catalog lookup, and Nexapp reporting, which let the team avoid standing up and synchronizing a separate search engine. That simpler architecture helped Nextar launch bespoke storefronts quickly, support hundreds of thousands of products, and improve uptime and latency while tuning performance and costs.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores inventory, order, and catalog data for each retailer storefront.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Search on Atlas
solution_components.role: Provides integrated product and catalog search for storefronts and internal applications.

data_flow: Sales, inventory, and catalog changes from each retailer flow into MongoDB Atlas, where per-store collections keep data current and MongoDB Search on Atlas powers storefront, catalog, and reporting queries without a separate sync pipeline.
business_outcome: Nextar kept retailers selling during lockdowns, improved uptime and latency, and simplified search operations without a separate search stack.
metrics: It is currently in use in more than 50,000 stores and over 190 countries.
Retailers now collectively offer hundreds of thousands of products via templated online storefronts, hosted by Nextar.
There were a dozen high-use queries using COLLSCAN - four of which were pretty slow (30-120s).
architecture_clues: Each shop operates as its own data collection with a specific store code for faster searches.
Every sale is synced to MongoDB and reflected in real time in the relevant catalog.
Atlas Search removed the need for a separate search engine and sync mechanism.
